summary_1line: Pandavas place Sikhandin at the front against Bhishma; fierce battle erupts as Bhishma devastates their forces yet refuses to fight Sikhandin.

image_candidates.scene_text: At sunrise, the Pandava army marches with drums and white conches blaring, Sikhandin standing at the very front with Arjuna and Bhima guarding his chariot wheels.
Bhishma alone on his chariot releases a storm of arrows in all directions, his bow drawn in a blazing circle as soldiers, elephants, and horses fall around him.
Sikhandin shoots three arrows into Bhishma’s chest while the grandsire, smiling and refusing to fight him, declares he will not battle one born a woman.
